updatedSnapshotSummary.warning: This is a snapshot-level descriptive result, not an independent-bet sample. Multiple lines are revisions of the same map thesis.

marketConclusions.moneylines: Underdog and draft-led moneyline leans remain weak without durable structural conversion.
marketConclusions.positiveUnderdogKillHandicaps: Wide cushions can perform well when return damage remains functional, but repeated same-thesis snapshots must not be treated as independent evidence.
marketConclusions.killOvers: Observed high-velocity and item-supported Overs performed materially better than draft-only or early-state Overs. DK-Gen.G Over 27.5 was an early volatility thesis that failed in a nine-kill map.
marketConclusions.killUnders: The DK-Gen.G Under 24.5 direction was correct in a controlled nine-kill close, but it was issued at a later and materially different state from the Over and should not be merged into one forecast.
marketConclusions.reentry: A failed or withdrawn handicap thesis requires demonstrated functional repair before another lean, regardless of a wider number.
